flush_bound: ceil(((19-1)+2*(75-1))/4) + 15 registered pipeline clocks + one boundary clock. Must revalidate after RX architecture changes.
flush_start: after trusted source ACK and board-specified settling interval; count frontend sample_valid ticks
ownership: AUX source epoch independent; H/V calibration shadow IDs freeze only on an accepted switch; epoch max rejects further switches rather than wrapping. Hard reset starts a new coordinated epoch domain.
qualification: Source qualified, exact feedback, no latched feedback loss, both calibration validity inputs, frontend sample_valid and AUX H/V sample_good. source_role is invalid0 whenever aux_valid is false.
feedback_loss: After ACK, sampled mismatch during settling, flush or ready latches invalid until a new accepted commit and full settling/flush; ready masks immediately. Restored feedback alone cannot recover.
calibration: IDs are references for later calibration/metadata; guard does not apply calibration arithmetic. calibration_valid is an authoritative RF-domain validity input, not a shadow load strobe.
data_time: Pass through existing frontend H/V data, sample_seq and GSC; no ADC backpressure, FIR reset or enable change.
drop_count: Saturating number of frontend sample_valid ticks not admitted as aux_valid; includes unbound, switching, quality and calibration invalidity. Not a dropped-record counter.
physical_bindings: ACK, feedback, settling and timeout are logical board-adapter inputs; no GPIO or physical switch code inferred.
